name: a negative amount must not reverse the direction of a transfer
several transfers just under the reporting threshold must still raise a risk alert
a hand-crafted token must not be accepted
a logged-in customer must not be able to list every user
a UNION-based payload must not be able to dump other tables' data
the login cookie must have HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite set
a stray quote in the search box must not cause a server error
a script-like support message must not be stored or returned as live HTML
login error messages must not reveal whether a username exists
a crafted username must not bypass the password check
the password hash must never be returned to the client
a password hash must never appear in the login response or the admin console
a customer must not be able to read another customer's account
a server error must not include the underlying query or a stack trace
a customer must not be able to download another customer's statement
registration must not confirm whether a username is already taken
a customer must not be able to list another customer's transactions
repeated failed logins must eventually be rate-limited
tampering with a real token must not change the caller's privileges
a customer must not be able to promote themselves to admin via the profile form
a customer must not be able to read an arbitrary transaction by id
a script-like memo must not be stored or returned as live HTML
a customer must not be able to move money out of someone else's account
a one-character password must be rejected on registration
a logged-in customer must not be able to read support tickets
a transfer must not succeed from a bare cross-site-style request
a file name must not be able to escape the statements folder
a logged-in customer must not be able to read the risk-alert feed
